{{Short description|Annual observance}}
'''International Women in Mathematics Day''' is held annually on May 12 to honor the achievements and contributions of women in mathematics and to foster an open and inclusive mathematical community. This date was chosen to commemorate the birthday of [[Maryam Mirzakhani]],<ref name="amsnotice"/><ref>{{cite web | website=May12 | url=https://may12.womeninmaths.org/why | title=Why May12? | access-date=2026-02-23}}</ref>

the first woman to receive the prestigious [[Fields Medal]], often regarded as the "[[Nobel Prize]] of mathematics".<ref name="k535">{{cite web | title=Stanford's Maryam Mirzakhani wins Fields Medal | website=Stanford Report | date=2014-08-12 | url=https://news.stanford.edu/stories/2014/08/stanfords-maryam-mirzakhani-wins-fields-medal | access-date=2025-05-13}}</ref> Mirzakhani, an Iranian mathematician and [[Stanford University]] [[professor]], was renowned for her groundbreaking work in geometry and dynamical systems. She died in 2017 at the age of 40.<ref name="h127">{{cite magazine | last=Roberts | first=Siobhan | title=Maryam Mirzakhani's Pioneering Mathematical Legacy | magazine=The New Yorker | date=2017-07-17 | url=https://www.newyorker.com/tech/annals-of-technology/maryam-mirzakhanis-pioneering-mathematical-legacy | access-date=2025-05-13}}</ref>

==History==
The "May 12 initiative" (later known as "May12 initiative"<ref name="may12"/>) to establish May 12 as International Women in Mathematics Day was spearheaded by the Women's Committee of the Iranian Mathematical Society and approved at the World Meeting for Women in Mathematics in Rio de Janeiro on July 31, 2018. In the sequel, the organization and coordination of the initiative was supported by the [[African Women in Mathematics Association]] (AWMA), [[European Women in Mathematics]], the [[Association for Women in Mathematics]], Indian Women and Mathematics and Colectivo de Mujeres Matemáticas de Chile. The website of the initiative, on which local organizers can publicize events, was launched on March 12, 2019. More than 100 events were registered for the first edition of the day in 2019.<ref name="amsnotice">{{cite journal |last1=Agarwal |first1=Nikita |last2=Araujo |first2=Carolina |last3=Bonfert-Taylor |first3=Petra |last4=Mahmoudi |first4=Mojgan |last5=Ouedraogo |first5=Marie Françoise |last6=Paris-Romaskevich |first6=Olga |last7=Roy |first7=Marie-Françoise |last8=Strickland |first8=Elisabetta |last9=Vera-Gajardo |first9=Andrea |title=May 12: Celebrating Women in Mathematics |journal=[[Notices of the American Mathematical Society]] |date=2019 |volume=66 |issue=11 |page=1 |doi=10.1090/noti1992 |doi-access=free}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | website=May12 | url=https://may12.womeninmaths.org/node/1327 | title=About | access-date=2026-02-23}}</ref>

Since its establishment in 2019, International Women in Mathematics Day has been observed annually, with more than 180 events held worldwide in 2024.<ref>{{cite web | website=May12 | title=2024 - 6th edition| url=https://may12.womeninmaths.org/2024 | access-date=2026-02-22}}</ref>

==Events==
Events held in observance of International Women in Mathematics Day in the period May 1 to June 15 are registered and publicized on the website of the May12 Initiative.<ref name="may12">{{cite web | website=May12 | title= May12| url=https://may12.womeninmaths.org/ | access-date=2026-02-23 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260115100804/https://may12.womeninmaths.org/ | archive-date=2026-01-15}}</ref> These include but are not limited to talks<ref name="j993"/>, exhibitions<ref>{{cite web | title=Exhibition "Remember Maryam Mirzakhani" (Temuco, Chile) | website=May12 | url=https://may12.womeninmaths.org/node/1108 | access-date=2026-02-23}}</ref>, workshops<ref>{{cite web | title=KWMS student reports work shop and annual events | website=May12 | url=https://may12.womeninmaths.org/node/1307 | access-date=2026-02-23}}</ref>, movie projections<ref>{{cite web | title=Screening of "Picture a Scientist" | website=May12 | url=https://may12.womeninmaths.org/node/1230 | access-date=2026-02-23}}</ref>, and events highlighting the work of women mathematicians and addressing the challenges they face<ref name="j993">{{cite web | title=International Women in Mathematics Day 2024, Melboure, Australia | website=May12 | url=https://may12.womeninmaths.org/node/1156 | access-date=2025-05-13}}</ref>. Events of this kind are held worldwide, mostly at academic institutions.
